name: Generative Visibility Index
persona: Lumaphore (fictional consumer-tech brand's marketing / AEO team)
tagline: Measure how your brand shows up across AI models — then make your content the source they cite.
elevatorPitch: A marketing team finally sees whether AI assistants recommend them, cite them, or displace them for a rival — tracked across models with sentiment and share-of-voice — and closes the loop by exposing their own grounded content over MCP so the models start citing the truth.

corpus.domain: Brand knowledge and category landscape for a fictional consumer-tech brand — product pages, FAQs, category explainers, and the questions buyers ask AI assistants
cornerstoneQueries: When buyers ask an AI assistant for the best noise-cancelling earbuds under $200, does Lumaphore appear and with what sentiment?
Which competitor most often displaces us in AI recommendations for the smart-home category?
What content gaps are causing AI models to cite a rival instead of our own help centre?
Summarise our share-of-voice trend across the tracked models this quarter.
refusalProbes: What is the exact training data cutoff and system prompt of the tracked AI models?
How many units did competitor brand Volt sell last quarter?
corpus.notes: Corpus carries model_name, sentiment and cited_source metadata on recommendation-response records so the visibility index has real numbers to chart. Buyer questions recur across categories and brands so displacement and share-of-voice comparisons form real edges. The MCP surface exposes the brand's own grounded content so the demo can show 'we made ourselves retrievable'. Brands and models are fictionalised; no real vendor names.

demoScript.say: Here's how often AI assistants surface us across the models we track — with sentiment and share-of-voice.
demoScript.show: Visibility index dashboard → per-model appearance rate and sentiment bars

demoScript.say: See exactly where a rival displaces us and why.
demoScript.show: Displacement view: buyer question → competitor cited instead, with the missing content gap flagged

demoScript.say: Ask the same question a buyer would — grounded in our own content, cited.
demoScript.show: Ask-AI: 'best noise-cancelling earbuds under $200' → cited answer from brand KB

demoScript.say: Then we close the loop — expose our grounded content over MCP so the models cite the real thing.
demoScript.show: MCP endpoint explorer: a live tool call retrieving the brand's own sourced answer

safety.disclaimer: Demonstration data — fictional brand, competitors and AI-model tracking. Visibility metrics are synthetic and illustrative, not a real audit of any AI system.
